text:
Sam W: RFC landed for a 'sidecar migration shim' — sketched a plan that lets us migrate old clients to v4 semantics without forcing client upgrades. Quick sanity check?
Priya N: love the idea, but what's the perf hit? sidecars + proxy hops can add latency.
Lee C: agree. also need to think about KV cache invalidation if shim rewrites streaming frames.
Marcos G: infra concern: sidecar per-pod increases memory; autoscaler will need new thresholds. do we want per-tenant or per-node sidecars?
Sam W: goal is per-pod sidecar initially for safety isolation. perf budget: +1–2ms p95 ideally. if not, fallback to in-proxy shim.
Olivia K: canary plan? we should gate by tenant and route small % first. also add strong telemetry for regressions.
Priya N: what about header-based opt-in so clients can opt in early? X-Redwood-Migrate: v4? parsing headers is cheap.
Lee C: header opt-in + header-based fallback works. downside: some SDKs might strip unknown headers (mobile/net proxies). need tenant opt-in server-side too.
Sam W: proposal: two-phase rollout: 1) server-side tenant opt-in + telemetry, 2) header opt-in for SDK preview, 3) enable by default with long deprecation.
Marcos G: capacity-wise we should reserve a small burst pool for sidecar-enabled pods. I'll pre-allocate 2% of cluster GPUs as buffer.
Olivia K: telemetry events: migration.attempt, migration.success, migration.fallback, migration.latency_ms. also capture model and seq_len distribution.
Lee C: adding a tiny snippet for the shim header handling:
```
# pseudo nginx config in sidecar
proxy_set_header X-Redwood-Migrate $http_x_redwood_migrate;
proxy_pass http://local-app:8080;
```
Sam W: and a sample fallback rule: if incompatible frame -> respond 409 with body {"reason": "incompatible-client"} so SDKs can auto-backoff. keep it explicit.
Priya N: tests needed: streaming end-to-end with prefix caching + shim; bench p50/p95 baseline vs shim. I'll own benchmarking.
Marcos G: ops checklist: reserve burst pool, add eviction policy note, update HPA thresholds, add sidecar image to fleet rollout playbook. I'll update infra runbook.
Olivia K: canary gating: start 0.1% tenants, watch errors and p95 for 48h, then 1%, then 5%, then 20%. abort if errors >0.5% or p95 regression >15%.
Sam W: assigning owners: Sam -> RFC follow-up + PoC; Priya -> perf bench; Lee -> implement telemetry + fallback codes; Marcos -> infra reserve + runbook; Olivia -> canary plan and metrics dashboard.
Priya N: one more: consider a light compatibility probe that pings affected endpoints to detect SDKs that strip headers automatically. could reduce surprises.
Lee C: good call. probe should simulate streaming frames and header combinations.
InfraBot: Deploy check triggered: sidecar-image:v0.1-poc -> canary cluster (no rollout yet). CI pipeline: tests/unit(23), integration(5).
Sam W: nice. I'll draft the follow-up RFC with exact signal definitions and thresholds. posting ETA: EOD tomorrow. :thumbsup:
